_README: Reference menu of MCP servers for the kit. `.mcp.json` (the active file Claude Code reads) ships
the CORE set only: serena, atlassian, context7, sequential-thinking, git, fetch.
Copy any OPTIONAL server below into `.mcp.json` when a repo needs it. setup.sh can do this.
Secrets are referenced by ${VAR} and supplied via a gitignored .env — never commit a token.
BANNED — do NOT use: @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres (CVE: SQL-injection / read-only
bypass) and @modelcontextprotocol/server-github (archived). Use crystaldba/postgres-mcp and the
Open agents (pi/Qwen/Crush/opencode) read their own MCP config — see agents-config/. The server
command/args/env below are identical; only Serena's --context changes (claude-code → agent/codex).
_optional: ----- OPTIONAL (copy into mcpServers above when needed) -----

filesystem._when: Core for OPEN agents (sandboxed file boundary they lack). Redundant under Claude Code — omit there.

postgres._when: DB-touching work only. ALWAYS --access-mode=restricted outside disposable local dev. Per-service DB URI.

playwright._when: UI repos only (OIDC Frontend, GraphQL playground). Drives the a11y tree — works without a vision model.

github._when: Richer PR/issue automation than the gh CLI. Remote OAuth endpoint — run /mcp to authenticate. Overlaps gh.

atlassian-remote-official._when: Cloud/OAuth ALTERNATIVE to sooperset for Claude users on Atlassian Cloud. No read-only/project-scoping controls; run /mcp to OAuth.
